cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of R04: the drawing is saved by the driver, so the file on disk changes (must FAIL)
cases.plan_item: red-before-green proof for R04 (UX-STD-03, daily case D18)
cases.expected: This variant is wrong on purpose: a save happens, so the file hash and time on disk differ from the start and R04's 'copy-unchanged' check fails. The checks before it (relinked, recovered, Pit Schedule closed) still pass.
cases.why_not_unit: It exists only to prove R04's file-unchanged check can go red when a save really happens in AutoCAD.
cases.setup_note: shared setup SETUP-P8 run here for the first time at 15:47:49

cases.title: CE never saves the drawing: the file stays unchanged until the drafter saves
cases.expected: After placing a pit and a pipe and running CDSYNC and CDRECOVERINVERTS, the drawing file on disk has the same SHA-256 and last-written time as when AutoCAD opened it, and the only new files beside it are CE's own _PRE_C7_ backups.
cases.why_not_unit: Only the real file on disk after a real AutoCAD session shows whether anything wrote to it.
not_automated: CDSYNC and CDRECOVERINVERTS here run on the drawing after SETUP-P8 (every case has its own fresh drawing); the checks only prove they ran and that the file on disk did not change.
PITSCHEDULE is opened and closed with its Close button (batch 3 fixes, 25 Oct 2026: D18 assertion 1 now covered); the window text is not read here (R38 and R25 read it).
CDREBUILD wording 'it does not save the drawing itself' (D18 assertion 2): CDREBUILD was dropped from this case because it has never been driven and its prompts are unknown.
